name: Coatue
history: Philippe Laffont founded Coatue in New York in 1999 as a technology hedge fund after working at Tiger Management, and his brother Thomas built its private investing. Since 2013 its venture and growth funds have backed Snap, Uber, Spotify, DoorDash, Anthropic and OpenAI. Its private funds hold about $40 billion of the $93 billion the firm manages, and the track record on this page covers the private investments only.
investment_concept: “Investing in innovation through public and private markets with responsible risk management.”
